source='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0,)]
    # Mark background cells strictly between same-color markers in a shared row or column.
    for i,(r,c) in enumerate(pts):
        for rr,cc in pts[i+1:]:
            if grid[r][c] != grid[rr][cc]:
                continue
            if r==rr:
                for x in range(min(c,cc)+1,max(c,cc)):
                    if grid[r][x] not in (grid[r][c],): out[r][x]=3
            elif c==cc:
